SUM(sale_price).sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, SUM(sale_price) AS value FROM sales WHERE purchased_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND purchased_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' GROUP BY product_id, product_name ORDER BY value DESC, product_id LIMIT 5

SUM(sale_price).definitions: scoped-retail-v1; sales contains qualifying item purchases, excluding Cancelled/Returned at both item and order level. transactions contains all current statuses. Revenue uses sale_price; orders and customers require distinct IDs. Brand scope applies before joins and history. purchased_at is the item's created_at. Use UTC half-open periods. Current statuses cannot reconstruct historical status changes. Currency is not specified. Customer geography is available only through query_state_summary.
